# Richter

> Static impact analysis for Laravel codebases. Given a branch diff, Richter reports the HTTP and CLI entry points the change can reach, flags the ones no test references, and attaches a coarse advisory risk level. It is a Composer dev dependency (`sandermuller/richter`), built on Laravel Brain, and it never executes the application's routes, jobs or commands.

Key properties an agent should know before using it:

- **Advisory by default.** `richter:detect-changes` exits 0. A low or empty result is a signal, not a guarantee of no impact. Gating is opt-in via `--fail-on` / `--fail-on-unresolved`.
- **Honest degradation.** A change the graph cannot place reads UNRESOLVED, never "no impact". Absence of an annotation means *not classified*, never a negative finding.
- **Member-level.** A one-method change seeds that method, not the whole class. An edit that changes no member correctly reports nothing.
- **Reference-based, not proof.** Test-reference tags and affected-test selection are recall heuristics, not coverage verdicts.
- **MCP server.** With `laravel/mcp` installed, every analysis is exposed read-only as a tool (`impact`, `trace`, `detect-changes`, `affected-tests`) plus three orientation resources. Tool output matches the CLI `--json` shape, so branch on fields rather than parsing prose. For `affected-tests`, `determinable: false` means run the full suite.

## Formats

- [llms-full.txt](https://sandermuller.github.io/richter/llms-full.txt): every page below, in reading order, in one fetch
- Any page is also served as markdown at its own URL plus `.md` (for example [coverage.md](https://sandermuller.github.io/richter/coverage.md))

## Docs

- [Why Richter?](https://sandermuller.github.io/richter/why-richter): what a report tells you, what it refuses to guess at, how the analysis runs
- [Installation](https://sandermuller.github.io/richter/installation): requirements (PHP 8.4+, Laravel 12/13), the `laravel/mcp` version constraint, the command list
- [Set up your project](https://sandermuller.github.io/richter/project-setup): the config keys that make the analysis accurate for a given app
- [Detecting change impact](https://sandermuller.github.io/richter/detect-changes): the main command, which diff is analysed, reading the report, `--explain`
- [Report annotations](https://sandermuller.github.io/richter/report-annotations): security exposure, Pennant gates, payload parity, middleware group membership — all advisory, none feed risk or the gate
- [Output formats](https://sandermuller.github.io/richter/output-formats): `--markdown`, `--html`, and the semver-governed `--json` key reference
- [Risk levels](https://sandermuller.github.io/richter/risk-levels): the hazard tiers, the reach matrix, and the ladder that decides the level
- [Gating in CI](https://sandermuller.github.io/richter/ci-gating): `--fail-on`, `--fail-on-unresolved`, a pull-request workflow, fork safety
- [Blast radius of a symbol](https://sandermuller.github.io/richter/impact): `richter:impact` — callers, dependencies, reached entry surfaces
- [Shortest path between symbols](https://sandermuller.github.io/richter/trace): `richter:trace` — call-direction chains and depth
- [Affected-test selection](https://sandermuller.github.io/richter/affected-tests): `richter:affected-tests` — selection mechanics and the exit-code contract (0 determined, 2 run the full suite, 1 error)
- [MCP server](https://sandermuller.github.io/richter/mcp-server): the read-only tools and resources, and their URIs
- [Coverage beyond Laravel Brain](https://sandermuller.github.io/richter/coverage): the edges traced beyond a route-anchored analysis, and the known limits
- [Troubleshooting](https://sandermuller.github.io/richter/troubleshooting): symptom index — empty reports, UNRESOLVED files, saturated risk, exit 2

## Optional

- [Frontend changes](https://sandermuller.github.io/richter/frontend): the opt-in Wayfinder/Ziggy bridge, in both directions
- [Graph cache](https://sandermuller.github.io/richter/graph-cache): the fingerprinted on-disk cache, profiling, scoped rebuilds
- [Configuration reference](https://sandermuller.github.io/richter/configuration): every key in `config/richter.php`
- [Benchmarking](https://sandermuller.github.io/richter/benchmark): scoring accuracy against replayable history
- [Source and issues](https://github.com/SanderMuller/richter)
